spans.s: Diti, the daughter of Daksha, the wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the Daityas. § 84 (Ādivaṃśāvatāraṇap.): I, 64, 2486 (ºeḥ putrāḥ, i.e. the Daityas).--§ 87 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2520 (daughter of Daksha and wife of Kaśyapa).--§ 89 (do.): I, 65, 2525 (mother of Hiraṇyakaśipu).--§ 130 (do.): I, 67, 2641 (ºeḥ putro Hiraṇyakaśipuḥ).--§ 237 (Vaivāhikap.): I, 193, †7176 (cakrāma Vajrīva Dºeḥ suteshu --i.e. the Daityas--sarvaiś ca devair ṛshibhiś ca jushṭaḥ).-§ 270 (Brahmasabhāv.): II, 11, 456 (in the palace of Brahmán).--§ 310 (Āranyakap.): III, 3, 155 (ºeḥ sutaḥ = Sūrya, but read with B. 'diteḥ suṭaḥ).--§ 422b (Naraka): III, 142, 10917 (ºeḥ sutaḥ, i.e. Naraka).--§ 441 (Nivātakavacayuddhap.): III, 165, †11909 (sapta pūgān Diteḥ sutānāṃ, i.e. the Daityas, slain by Indra).--§ 444 (do.): III, 169, 12094 (ºeḥ putrāḥ, i.e. the Nivātakavacas).--§ 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 110, 3808 (atra--i.e. in the west-devīṃ Ditim ātmaprasavadhāriṇīṃ | vigarbhām akarec Chakro yatra jāto Marudgaṇaḥ).--§ 596 (Pratijñāp.): VII, 73, 2608 (ºeḥ puraṃ).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 68, †3393 (tava Kunti putro jāto Diter Vishnur ivārihantā, but read 'diter with B.).--§ 664 (Mokshadh.): XII, 207, 7537 (eldest daughter of Daksha), 7545 (mother of the Asuras).-§ 714 (Śukakṛtya): XII, 329, 12417 (evam ete Dºeḥ putrā Mārutāḥ paramādbhutāḥ, i.e. the winds; B. and Nīl. read 'diteḥ, but cf. V, 3808).--§ 719b (Gautamī-lubdhaka-vyālaMṛtyu-Kāla-saṃv.): XIII, 1, 55 (PCR. has Aditi).-§ 730g (Upamanyu): XIII, 14, 796 (ºeḥ sutān, i.e. the Daityas).

(ºāḥ) (“the sons of Diti”) = Daitya, pl. § 28 (Amṛtamanthana): I, 19, †1180 (Diti-Danujān, vanquished by Nārāyaṇa).--§ 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2667 (ºśreshṭhaḥ …Candraḥ).--§ 333 (Kairātap.): III, 40, †1662 (º-Piśācasūdanaṃ…Gāṇḍīvaṃ).--§ 359 (Vaḍavā): III, 82, 5037.--§ 558 (Virocana): V, 35, 1188.--§ 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 97, 3518.--§ 589 (Droṇābhishek.): VII, 6, 161 (ºānām ivośanāḥ śreshṭhaḥ).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 89, †4594 (yathā Sureśo Dºaiḥ kshatāṅgaḥ).--§ 666 (Mokshadh.): XII, 209, 7619 (antarbhūmiṃ sampraviśya jagāma Dºān prati, sc. Vishṇu incarnate as a boar).--§ 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 14, 971 (ºsaṅghānāṃ mardanaṃ, i.e. Śiva).
Ditinandana^1 (“son of Diti”) = Hiraṇyakaśipu: III, 15834; XII, 12943.
